_doc: The woolback's surfaces (Ch12 wildlife, M4-A2P-056; docs/kb/plan/act2/creatures/woolback.md): the Avalanche Ram's slots without the seep and the ice. Slots are the glTF material names; write_materials.py writes assets/creatures/woolback/materials/<slot>.tres on game/shaders/creature/creature.gdshader. fleece is the coat, the six chains of locks (sun-bleached toward bone at the tips where the ram's are frosted), the mane, the head and ears (undyed sand_cloth gone grey to overcast_slate); its wetness barely shows (the ram's ice plates are dry bleached wool here: a high wet roughness, little clearcoat), and it has no emission. hide is the darkened laterite legs, the nostrils, the hooves and the faded lacquer_red herd-cord; eye is wet lacquer_black. Colours are palette.json swatches.
